diagram_candidates.rationale: The Statement is explicitly about a fibre-product square and a canonical map induced by its projections; a displayed cartesian square would expose the base-change geometry at a glance.
diagram_candidates.concrete_maps: Cartesian square with X′ on the upper left, X on the upper right, S′ on the lower left and S on the lower right: top map g: X′→X, right map f: X→S, left projection X′→S′, and bottom map S′→S. The two composites X′→S agree; the statement then gives g*Ω_{X/S}→Ω_{X′/S′}.
